proposition.claim:
The ring is the coordinate ring of the cone over an open positroid variety, with the necklace Plücker coordinates inverted. Definition 3.4 requires the frozen-monomial condition, an isomorphism after coefficient specialization, and compatibility of the \(\widehat y\) variables. Equality of the sets of ordinary cluster variables is a stronger assertion and is not the theorem. Connectedness is imposed before using the boundary algebra and its categorifications; the disconnected case is treated geometrically first. Remark 3.8 also explicitly excludes the stronger conjecture concerning every relabelled cluster structure.

The raw generic-fibre dimension agrees with the normalized rank formulas and with rank1 of the specified vertex modules.
